memories.text: Bake sourdough: feed the starter the evening before, mix and fold the dough, proof overnight in the fridge, and bake at 240 degrees in a covered pot for 40 minutes.

steps: feed the starter the evening before
mix the dough and do four stretch-and-folds
bake at 240 degrees in a covered pot for 40 minutes

memories.text: The oven runs 15 degrees hotter than its dial says; set it 15 degrees lower.
Never put the chef's knives in the dishwasher; wash and dry them by hand.
When planning meals or recipes, exclude peanuts and keep dishes vegetarian unless the user asks otherwise.
memories.note: personal constraints that apply to any food question

memories.text: Chose chickpea curry as the standard Sunday meal prep because it freezes well.
Fix a boiler that shows low pressure: check the gauge, open the filling loop slowly until it reads 1.5 bar, close it, and bleed the radiators.

steps: open the filling loop slowly until it reads 1.5 bar

memories.text: The boiler is serviced every October by the installer; the last service was on 18 October.
Test the smoke detectors on the first of every month and replace the batteries each spring.
In summer water the vegetable beds in the early morning and skip watering after rain.
In winter drain the outdoor tap, cover the pots with fleece, and do not prune the roses.
Paper is collected on the first Tuesday of the month, plastic every second Thursday, and glass goes to the bank at the supermarket.

fields.subject: recycling
fields.object: paper first Tuesday, plastic second Thursday

memories.text: The car is an electric car with a 60 kWh battery; charge to 80% for daily use and 100% only before long trips.
Tyre pressure is 2.5 bar at the front and 2.7 bar at the rear when the car is loaded.
Tyre pressure is 2.2 bar all round.
Book the annual car service: call the garage, ask for the brake fluid check, and arrange a loan car.

steps: ask for the brake fluid check

memories.text: Keep fixed costs under 55% of net income and move 15% to savings on payday.
Monthly budget check: add up fixed costs, subtract them from net income, and compare the remainder with the 30% variable spending target.

steps: compare the remainder with the variable spending target

memories.text: Packing for a trip: passport, chargers, medication, one jacket, and a printed copy of the booking; weigh the bag the night before.

steps: weigh the bag the night before

memories.text: The passport expires on 4 May 2027; many countries require six months of validity.
Take the allergy tablet in the morning with food, and remind the user when the packet is nearly empty.
The first aid kit is in the hall cupboard and the emergency number is 112.
Order groceries on Thursday evening for Saturday delivery; staples are oat milk, lentils, rice, and eggs.
On 2026-02-03 a washing machine hose burst and flooded the kitchen; the insurer paid after the receipts were sent.
Replace the washing machine hoses every five years and close the tap when leaving for more than a day.

fields.situation: going away from home with appliances connected
fields.insight: old hoses burst and flood the kitchen
fields.do_instead: replace hoses every five years and close the tap

memories.text: Renew the home insurance and compare two quotes first.
Replace the garage light bulb.
Plastic is collected every Monday.
